NooK Messenger protects your SMS with robust end-to-end encryption (AES-256-GCM).

⚠️ By proceeding, you declare that you have understood and accept that:

Legal Compliance: You are solely responsible for complying with laws regarding the use of encryption in your jurisdiction.

Legitimate Use: This tool is designed solely for personal privacy. Any illegal use is strictly prohibited.

Technical Limits: Standard SMS metadata (phone numbers, timestamps) remains visible to your carrier.

Recipient Requirement: The recipient must also use NooK to read your encrypted messages.

The Owner of the NooK APP defines trusted contacts, for whom NooK - if running - decrypts encrypted SMS (from another NooK from the trusted contact's number).

🔐 Required Permissions & Why:

SMS: To send and receive encrypted messages.

CONTACTS: To select recipients and use their phone numbers to create (encrypted) chats.

PHONE (Read Phone State): For Android up to (excluding) 16 - to identify your phone number as part of the encryption process.

MEDIA: If you make a backup or restore a chat, NooK must be able to read and write files on your device.

NooK is open-source and does not collect/share data.

ALWAYS BE AWARE OF:

a) Which keyboard you are using (some keyboards share data!)
B) Screenshots taken without your knowledge by other APPs (activate protection in NooK),
C) Be mindful of the Clipboard, which shares text with apps that have permission!

🚨 SECURITY AND LIABILITY NOTICE:

The application has been tested for months on Samsung and Google Pixel devices.

HOWEVER, USE THIS APP AT YOUR OWN RISK.

The app, like any active software, can contribute to increased CPU usage, battery consumption, and consequent device overheating, especially when used in combination with other applications or in extreme environmental conditions (e.g., in direct sunlight).

IN NO EVENT SHALL THE DEVELOPER OR CONTRIBUTORS OF NOOK BE HELD LIABLE for any direct or indirect damage to your device, including, but not limited to: abnormal overheating, battery damage, data loss, malfunctions, battery explosions, fires, or personal injuries resulting from the use of this application.

It is your exclusive responsibility:
1. To monitor the condition of your phone or tablet during use.
2. To use only original or certified batteries and chargers.
3. To immediately stop use and turn off the device in case of overheating.
4. To ensure adequate ventilation for the device.
5. To use the app in accordance with the device manufacturer's guidelines.
